newsitem.title: USA: SmarTalk in pact with Choice Hotels.
newsitem.headline: SmarTalk in pact with Choice Hotels.

text.p: SmarTalk Teleservices Inc said Thursday that it has an agreement with Choice Hotels International Inc to market its prepaid long distance calling card products to more than 2,800 properties in the United States.
The five-year, exclusive agreement allows SmarTalk to sell prepaid long distance calling card products to the properties for distribution to travelers.

The agreement also paves the way for SmarTalk to sell through ATM machines located at the properties and to provide cards for incentive marketing programs including those targeting frequent travelers.
SmarTalk manufactures and distributes prepaid calling cards and other telecommunications products.
